draft_text: Wrenfold's advantage over Fennick-Base may extend to customer-service domains not seen in training.
revised_text: Wrenfold's advantage over Fennick-Base extends to the held-out customer-service domains (Insurance, Telecom and Utilities), where it scores higher on macro-F1 in each case.
rationale: T1.r3–r5 show Wrenfold higher than Fennick-Base on all three held-out domains. The hedge "may extend" understates the complete evidence; no statistical test is reported, so the claim should state the observed advantage without significance language.
